description: Held-out planning tasks for the optional local planner. Never train on these. Each case names the tools a correct plan uses (tools_all: every one; tools_any: at least one), an optional preference that retrieved memory should steer into the arguments, or refuse=true when no executable plan should come back. Scope is read_only unless stated.
